description: An inviting exterior covered entryway passage of a white farmhouse-style home with charming cottage character. The structure features white shiplap siding, thick square columns with stacked natural limestone bases, and an open gabled porch ceiling lined with white-painted shiplap boards pitched at a gentle angle. A pair of warm honey-toned wood gates with chevron plank pattern and matte black iron hardware stand open, framing a straight path of grey painted wood decking that leads to a black-painted front door with multi-pane glazed upper panels. Two terracotta pots flank the front door, planted with small green shrubs. On the left column, a climbing rose vine twines upward in profuse white bloom, its canes laced loosely around the column. Lavender and silver-leafed dusty miller spill from the foreground garden beds. A clipped boxwood sphere and architectural agave succulent anchor the lower right. Black-trimmed multi-pane windows are set into the white siding on both sides. Warm amber glows hang from the porch ceiling in two positions along the passage — a forward position and a receding one — casting intimate pools of gold against the white ceiling boards and illuminating the passageway to the front door with inviting warmth. The passage reads as a one-point perspective corridor framed by the gate posts and columns. Camera at standing eye-level, slightly wide lens, centered one-point perspective looking directly down the entryway path toward the front door. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
